corrections.software_time: A negative coordinate timestamp inside Genesis is a model label and is not physical proper-time evidence. Backdating does not create a causal cycle.
corrections.dirac_topology: The intrinsic topology is pi_1(SO(3)) = Z2. Odd 2pi toggling has no parity fixed point; two toggles restore the Z2 register.
corrections.burovchik_W: W in Z is an auxiliary signed history encoder/counter. It is not an additional topological invariant of SO(3).
corrections.material_memory: Material/SCOBY memory obstructs exact closure only when its full one-loop map has no admissible fixed point. A relaxing affine map can possess a fixed point.
corrections.stochastic_NOT: The 1/2,1/2 stationary state is classified as a classical stochastic/Markov analog, not a full Deutsch quantum-CTC calculation.
corrections.entropy_signature: An Ed25519 receipt proves provenance and integrity, not unconditional unpredictability or isolation of authority private state.
corrections.information_bound: Chance matching is bounded using conditional min-entropy H_inf(T | view_at_freeze); semantic-class entropy is not counted unless independently established.

independent_future_gate.critical_case: A simulator with foreknowledge can create an exact signed structural match. Genesis correctly refuses promotion when entropy independence is not externally established.
independent_future_gate.unresolved_case: A compromised entropy authority can be structurally indistinguishable from a valid signed transcript; transcript-only verification cannot solve this trust boundary.
required_external_trust: separate host or hardware entropy source

information_theory.boundary: These are ideal conditional-min-entropy bounds, not standalone empirical p-values and not proof of retrocausality.

next_gate: Build an external/hardware-separated Independent-Future Bench Gate; Genesis remains the verifier/sandbox, not the physical retrocausal channel.
